bullets.text: Node.js MCP on Azure Functions - **Azure Functions** now supports hosting **Node.js** MCP servers for scalable, serverless deployment.
Beazley Collaboration Boosts Cyber Resilience - **Microsoft** partners with **Beazley** to enhance incident response and cyber resilience.
AI Dev Days Event - Join **Microsoft** for AI Dev Days on December 10-11 to explore the latest in AI innovation.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Released - New **Windows 11** build introduces native support for **MCP** and enhanced features.
Leader in Email Security - **Microsoft** recognized as a leader in the 2025 **Gartner Magic Quadrant** for Email Security.
Prioritize Cybersecurity Strategies - **Microsoft** emphasizes essential cybersecurity strategies to combat evolving threats.
Microsoft 365 Enhancements Announced - **Microsoft 365** to receive new AI capabilities and pricing updates in 2026.
Copilot Business for SMBs - **Microsoft 365 Copilot Business** launched, offering AI solutions tailored for small businesses.
Building Future-Ready Cybersecurity Teams - **Microsoft** discusses the need for innovative talent strategies in cybersecurity.
